notes.title: Holiday Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26936774/e0aa4a82dc50270f15b084eb9a0c7ec611a771e2.png[/img]

Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays, everyone! To go along with our Winter Sale discount, we're putting out a few more cards for you to try and play around with! Check out their abilities below. We hope everyone has a wonderful holiday season, and gets some good game time in!

Nothern Warbear - Any unit this card attacks cannot move on its next turn.
Great Glacial Pine - Whenever an enemy unit dies, reduce this card's health and spawn a lesser glacial pine. These increase the defence of nearby units.
Well of Souls - Gets healed any time an allied unit dies, and can reduce its health to heal allied units in return.
Crystallize - Select an allied unit. It can no longer move, but gets its attack range increased to 5.
Inspire - Gain 1 Unit Point for the rest of the game.
Deconstruction - Destroy a structure you control to draw 2 cards.
Rune of Insight - Reveal 3 cards in your opponent's hand.

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26936774/712d3151698273807a69d1673000fa68009a3c26.png[/img]

Hey everybody, and Happy Halloween! We've got a few spooky new cards and less spooky new fixes for you to enjoy. We've also added a brand new map to the game, Inferno. We hope you enjoy them!
Here's the full list:

New Cards:
Demonic Tunneller: Destroys adjacent structures after it moves.
Mimic Ooze: Copies the attack of the highest unit within 4 hexes.
Haunting: Select an allied unit, when it dies, summon a Fallen Soldier.
Sacrificial Flames: Destroy an allied unit to add any card from your deck to your hand.
Hellish Restraints: Select an enemy unit. It cannot move on its next turn.

Bug Fixes:
-Spires now animate properly on Crossing.
-Can no longer spawn units on top of enemy units at the bridge spawn zones.
-Will no longer drag map while selecting cards from hand, deck, discard pile for an ability.
-Fixed an issue that affected AI interactions with targeted abilities.
-Fixed a bug where Hades would vanish if played online.
-Game will no longer hang if AI has to discard cards at end of turn.

Balance Adjustments:
- Armour Coating no longer affects Commanders.

notes.title: Sea Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26936774/e10bad269ca0601e174faa74453fe723ce928727.png[/img]

Hi everyone, we're pleased to give you some new cards to play around with! We're greatly expanding the Sea unit faction, adding 5 cards to use: Honour Guard, Mer Mystic, Mer King, Mer Queen and Mer Piercer. 

The King and Queen under the sea provide powerful benefits for their underwater brethren, and the Mer Mystic uses her powers to capture crystals at range. The Honour Guard is great for defending your base or your high value units, while the Mer Piercer is specifically designed to take down things larger than herself.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26936774/202a11388cd177fb01e600289b6640228688b2b7.png[/img]

We're also adding a few new spells to use in this update as well. Attrition is a spell that weakens the attack of cards. Commander's Sacrifice allows you to give up base health to heal your units. Recruit lets you add a copy of a card on the map to your hand, and Whirlpool gives one of your units a powerful debuff effect to help you break enemy lines.

We hope you all enjoy these cards, and are looking forward to more from us in the future!

notes.title: 0.9.1 patch
notes.content:
We are pleased to release our first patch for Legions of Tyrandel! We've been hard at work since our release and this is the first of many improvements to come. This patch addresses several things to improve the overall game experience, making it easier to play cards and interact with the game. Full patch notes below.

FIXES:
-Adjusted Puzzle 1
-Fixed [FAILED] commands when upgrading specific minions
-Fixed an issue where the AI would still play minions after being hit by Cold Front

BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS:
-Commander’s Call boost can no longer be negated
-Outpost can be played adjacent to your units via the normal Play command, without needing to use Special Play

GAMEPLAY ADJUSTMENTS:
-Cards can now be played via drag and drop
-Spells and abilities that target cards on the map can now be cancelled after viewing targets.
-Spires can be captured by clicking on them while a unit’s movement range is displayed
-The map can be moved by dragging the mouse
-Instead of losing immediately when running out of cards, players now take an increasing amount of damage every turn until they run out of health

ART ADJUSTMENTS:
-Added a visual effect when units and structures are spawned
-Improved the look of the card command UI
-Added a visual effect when spires are captures
